runner: Node v26.13.0 on Windows, Express and disposable MongoDB 7.0.24
stockScenarios: Opening count, coverage, decimal validation and patient-scoped reads
Fault after debit rolls back balance, ledger and dose
Concurrent distinct doses and duplicate submissions deduct once per action
Insufficient stock preserves the dose and explicit retry uses the current action
Threshold checklist collection and completion have zero stock effect
Fractional refills, concurrent negative corrections and schedule pause
Legacy and incompatible doses preserve history, and archived items are excluded from low-stock lists
environmentNote: The standalone MongoDB fixture used a disposable workspace directory because the Windows sandbox denied a WiredTiger file rename in its default temporary directory.
